title: List Container
description: A header, a scrolling body and a footer around a list, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: the header and footer stay put while the rows scroll, with empty, loading and error renders of its own; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — status and time move to a trailing column at @sm, sit side by side and the heading grows at @md, and the times line up in one column at @lg.
